jin: Quick heads-up — reproduced a deterministic drift after long prefill on magnet-13b-int8. Repro attached.
jin: Steps I ran:
```
./run_infer.sh --model magnet-13b-int8 --seq 32768 --prefill 32000 --batch 1 --seed 42 > repro.log
```
jin: Observed that tokens 32015..32025 diverge from baseline (float32) — not gradual, abrupt mismatch.
marta: thanks. Do you have KV dump? Is it an index wrap or truncation?
jin: KV dump shows duplicate key indices around 8191/8192 boundaries, e.g.:
```
KV[8190]: h=0xabc...
KV[8191]: h=0xdef...
KV[0]:    h=0xdef...
```
alex: hmm looks like circular buffer off-by-one when we hit 8k slots. Our sharding aligns to 8k. Are you using adaptive_trim?
jin: yes, dedicated run with adaptive_trim enabled (old heuristic). If I force trim=fixed (remove oldest by tokens) divergence disappears.
sam: hypothesis: adaptive_trim uses byte-size of serialized KV pages; when quantized (int8) sizes change per token, it trims mid-token leading to broken KV alignment.
marta: that would explain sudden discontinuity. Any repro with int4/int8 differences?
jin: int4 also shows problem but threshold earlier in the sequence. float32 no problem.
alex: let's add a unit test in runtime: fill KV to N-1, then append 2 tokens and assert no duplicated index and that rotary phases monotonic. Also add a check in trim code: only drop whole token entries not partial chunks.
qa: can you paste failing top-of-log (llm tokens + logits)?
jin: pasted below — truncated:
```
[INFO] prefill=32000 kv_slots=8192 used=8190
[WARN] trimming bytes=4096 => dropped=2047.5 tokens
[ERR] next_token mismatch at pos=32015 expected='the' got='Ġthe' (bpe-split)
```
dev-bot: CI run queued: eng-ml/kvcache-trim-unit on bench-dedicated-1 (ETA 20m)
sam: tentative fix: change adaptive_trim to compute token_count = ceil(bytes / bytes_per_token_estimate) then round up to nearest token boundary using BPE map. Also add per-shard sentinel to detect wrap.
marta: low-risk patch. can you throw up PR with perf numbers? this may slightly increase memory usage.
jin: will open PR with microbench: cost of new rounding <0.5% mem; eliminates divergence in int8 test.
alex: also request a long-run nightly job: bench/kvcache/overflow-48k with int8 and int4 variants.
qa: noted. I'll add test vector to regression suite and tag it as blocking for model-onboard.
sam: we should also add a small probe metric: kv_index_dup_rate (per 1M tokens) so we detect future regressions automatically.
marta: thanks team :thumbsup:
alex: assign to @jin and @sam for follow-up; leaving notes in the issue.
jin: creating issue now — link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-3219
qa: I'll verify after PR lands and re-run the repro suite.
marta: great — keep the thread updated.
